# AnimotionJS Skills

AI coding agent skills for the AnimotionJS animation library. Install directly into your favorite AI agent with NPM or fetch via CDN.

## Features

- **15 Agents Supported:** Copilot, Cursor, Claude, OpenCode, Windsurf, Cody, Codium, Aider, Continue, Cline, Codex, Roo, Amazon Q, Augment, JetBrains AI
- **Two Tiers:** Agentic (recreate pasted prompts, website links and videos strictly with AnimotionJS), Studio (deprecated alias of Agentic - same skill)
- **Plan Entitlement:** `agentic` and `studio` are licensed by the Studio plan ($15/month)
- **Skill Commands:** `/command   type` - `/recreate` (website link or description), `/video` (recreate from a video), `/animate`, plus one command per feature area: `/core`, `/scroll`, `/text`, `/pointer`, `/media`, `/three`, `/attr`, `/plugins`, `/plugin`, `/oil`, `/ease`, `/perf`, `/a11y`, `/docs`, `/help`
- **NPM Package:** Installer only — skill text, docs and the layer library download from the CDN with your license, so no skill source ships in the tarball
- **CDN Access:** Fetch skill files directly via HTTP (license required)
- **No-Code Support:** JSONP, script loaders, embed widgets

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install globally
npm install -g animotion-skills
animotion-skills install --license-key=YOUR_KEY

# Or use npx
npx animotion-skills install --license-key=YOUR_KEY

# Install for specific agent
npx animotion-skills install --agent=copilot --license-key=YOUR_KEY

# Agentic tier (default) - the recreate-everything skill (Studio plan, $15/month)
npx animotion-skills install --tier=agentic --license-key=YOUR_KEY

# Legacy alias (Studio tier), installs the identical skill:
npx animotion-skills install --tier=studio --license-key=YOUR_KEY
```

## CLI Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `--agent=<name>` | Install for specific agent |
| `--all` | Install for all detected agents |
| `--tier=<agentic\|studio>` | Select tier (default: agentic) |
| `--license-key=<key>` | License key (required) |
| `--admin-email=<email>` | Admin email (team licenses) |
| `--admin-secret=<secret>` | Admin secret (team licenses) |
| `--force` | Overwrite existing files |
| `--detect` | Detect installed agents |

## CDN Access

```bash
# Agentic tier (auth required, Studio plan)
curl -H "X-License-Key: KEY" https://skills.animotion.click/cdn/agentic/opencode

# Studio tier - deprecated alias of agentic, identical file
curl -H "X-License-Key: KEY" https://skills.animotion.click/cdn/studio/opencode

# References and plugin catalog (Studio plan - license required)
curl -H "X-License-Key: KEY" https://skills.animotion.click/cdn/docs/IMPERATIVE-API
curl -H "X-License-Key: KEY" https://skills.animotion.click/cdn/docs/DECLARATIVE-ATTRIBUTES
curl -H "X-License-Key: KEY" https://skills.animotion.click/cdn/plugins
curl -H "X-License-Key: KEY" https://skills.animotion.click/cdn/agents

# Layer library index and search (no auth)
curl https://skills.animotion.click/cdn/library
```

## Programmatic API

```javascript
const { AnimotionSkills } = require('animotion-skills');

const skills = new AnimotionSkills('YOUR_KEY');
const agentic = await skills.getSkill('agentic', 'opencode'); // Studio plan
const studio = await skills.getSkill('studio', 'opencode'); // alias of agentic
```
